id: # An instruction consists of one starter / optional filters / one picker / optional suffixes. The starter and picker are required.
# The starter comes first and determines the order type. It takes no parameters.
# Filters follow the starter and narrow the target pool. They can be chained and take parameters in parentheses.
# The picker follows all filters and selects a single target. It takes no parameters.
# Suffixes follow the picker and set special options. They can be chained and take parameters in parentheses.
# Separate instructions with newlines or semicolons.
# Instructions are attempted in sequence. The first successfully issued order takes effect; if all attempts fail the ship resumes autonomous behavior.
# Instructions are enabled when the fleet mode is neither default_ai nor full_assault.

name: Assault
desc: Issues an Assault order targeting enemy-held and neutral objectives.

name: Avoid
desc: Issues an Avoid order targeting enemy ships.

name: Capture
desc: Issues a Capture order targeting enemy-held and neutral objectives.

name: Control
desc: Issues a Control order targeting friendly-held objectives.

name: Defend
desc: Issues a Defend order targeting friendly-held objectives.

name: Eliminate
desc: Issues an Eliminate order targeting enemy ships.

name: Engage
desc: Issues an Engage order targeting enemy ships.

name: Escort
desc: Issues an Escort order targeting friendly ships.

name: Fighter strike
desc: Issues a Fighter Strike order targeting enemy ships.

name: Harass
desc: Issues a Harass order targeting enemy ships.

name: Retreat
desc: Issues a Retreat order targeting the issuing ship itself.

name: Clear order
desc: Clears the current order targeting the issuing ship itself.

name: Distance
desc: Filters any target pool by distance. Use distance(maximum) or distance(minimum, maximum). Targets within the specified range are retained.

name: Hull size
desc: Filters ship targets by hull size using hullsize(size). Sizes include frigate/destroyer/cruiser/capital; multiple sizes form a union. smallest/largest select the smallest or largest size within the specified sizes; using both retains both extremes. Used alone these selectors consider the entire candidate pool.

name: Hull type
desc: Filters ship targets by type using hulltype(type). Types include any/phase/carrier; multiple types can be combined. Ships matching any specified type are retained.

name: Own flux
desc: Checks the issuing ship's flux using selfFlux(maximum) or selfFlux(minimum, maximum). Plain numbers specify absolute flux; values ending in % specify percentages. The instruction continues when the ship's flux meets the requirement and stops otherwise.

name: Own hull integrity
desc: Checks the issuing ship's hull integrity using selfHp(maximum) or selfHp(minimum, maximum). Plain numbers specify hitpoints; values ending in % specify percentages. The instruction continues when the ship's hull integrity meets the requirement and stops otherwise.

name: Target flux
desc: Filters ship targets by flux using targetFlux(maximum) or targetFlux(minimum, maximum). Plain numbers specify absolute flux; values ending in % specify percentages. All targets are checked by their actual flux including overloaded ships.

name: Target hull integrity
desc: Filters ship targets by hull integrity using targetHp(maximum) or targetHp(minimum, maximum). Plain numbers specify hitpoints; values ending in % specify percentages. Targets meeting the hull integrity requirement are retained.

name: Target speed
desc: Filters ship targets by maximum speed using targetSpeed(maximum) or targetSpeed(minimum, maximum). self represents the issuing ship's maximum speed. Targets within the specified speed range are retained.

name: Nearest target
desc: Selects the nearest candidate as the order target.

name: Spread targets
desc: Keeps the current target while the issuing ship is its sole executor of this task type and the target remains eligible. Otherwise prefers the nearest target with zero actual executors of that task type, then falls back to the nearest target.

name: Concentrate targets
desc: Prefers the nearest target already assigned actual executors of the same task type, then falls back to the nearest target.

name: Random target
desc: Selects a random candidate as the order target. Recommended for starters that target the issuing ship itself.

name: Priority
desc: Sets the override priority using priority(value). The value must be finite and defaults to 0. Tasks of the same type on the same target use the highest priority requested by current participants; a different task type takes over only with a strictly higher priority. External assignments retain ownership.

name: Keep target
desc: Keeps a valid target that still meets the filters while this instruction succeeds continuously. Switching instructions or a change in task ownership triggers target selection again.
